description: This file manages checkpoint restoration operations for tasks, including handling delete and edit operations, and provides utility for waiting until task initialization. It interacts with task management, persistence, and VSCode APIs.

methods.name: handleCheckpointRestoreOperation
methods.description: Performs checkpoint restoration for delete or edit operations, handling task abort, setting pending edits, saving messages, and reinitializing tasks.

methods.name: waitForClineInitialization
methods.description: Waits for the task to be initialized within a specified timeout, showing an error message if timeout occurs.
